name: Manage Projects (CRUD)
summary: Create, rename, archive, delete projects. Assign or unassign agents.

steps.note: create_project(name,vision) | update_project(name,field,value) | archive_project(name) | delete_project(name) | assign_agent(agent_id,project_name) | unassign_agent(agent_id,project_name)
delete_project is irreversible — confirm with user if not explicit. archive_project is always safe (reversible).

notes: archive ≠ delete: archive hides from active view but is recoverable. Delete is permanent.
User says 'delete' → use delete_project. User says 'remove' or 'hide' → archive_project.
